    std::vector<std::vector<long long>> tree_counts(36, std::vector<long long>(36, 0));
    tree_counts[0][0] = 1;

    for (int total = 1; total < 36; ++total) {
        for (int minh = 0; minh <= total; ++minh) {
            for (int root_idx = 1; root_idx <= total; ++root_idx) {
                int left_part = root_idx - 1;
                int right_part = total - root_idx;

                long long term1 = left_zero * right_zero;
                long long term2 = (left_zero - (left_part >= 0 ? tree_counts[left_part][std::max(minh - 1, 0)] : 0))

                tree_counts[total][minh] += term1 - term2;
            }
        }
    }
